notes.title: DevBlog: Ambush
notes.content:
Woohoo! we just completed milestone two!
Alright, alright. Bad attempts at making a pun aside, this Steam post will touch on some of the progress we've made since the last one.

New Enemy's
of which there are 16!
Yep, from Humans to Halflings and Minators, we have a whole new cast of enemies ready and waiting to be ambushed. there are a bit too many types to fit into just one post, so here is a select few that we would like to highlight:

The Peasants
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43909477/20297431d4bacb19f8d9f9dc9cc98d7e0d48ca90.gif

These are the peasants, the most common and maybe even the easiest enemies to rob. Armed with bows, pitchforks, and some weak magic, they don't pose much of a threat alone, but don't be fooled by them when grouped together; they can put up a fight.

The Merchants
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43909477/6af977d77d3b803612c7b4b78bd1104cbbf22854.gif

Next up we have Merchants, the ones who often have so much valuable loot, that they need servants to carry their plentiful wealth for them, robbing them yields great wealth.

The Guards
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43909477/336e3daff8c33962df5e572cfba55fff79babded.gif

Finally, we have the guards, well trained and armed with the time's finest armor and weapons; these enemies will be the most resilient to your ambush; they traverse the road to protect the innocent.

Enemy Patrol
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43909477/797d2e9973fedead0ba363c9b41b6dc21e8245cd.gif

Afraid of the unknown, enemies tend to stick to the beaten path, meaning they are predictable and perfect for planning an ambush on. Enemies will follow roads and bridges.

Hide Defensive Aggressive
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43909477/b60e0ed1a369d5186db40f2c61cd8b60d973509d.gif

This brings us to how you can plan your ambush. There are two main states your units can take on being aggressive and defensive; this will determine if they will fight on the front lines or hang around from a distance; this is represented by the sword and shield icons to the left of the health bar. But you may have also noticed an eye above the health bar; this shows you whether the unit is hidden or visible to the enemy convoy; both are okay if you have the right strategy!

Draw and Drop Units
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43909477/64a24ba25d2017d683b451561740f063798778b5.gif

We have been experimenting with different ways to position units in the combat area. In the gif above, you can see how you can easily view and drag your available units onto the battlefield. The icons mentioned in the previous segment can also be seen in action here. Depending on where you place your unit, they can be either visible or hidden.

Making Levels
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43909477/c1f7206d4ba0bbb66bf90601e12df4ffd546a632.gif

Continuing with our running theme of having a new visual style for Outlaw Kingdom, the environments needed a new coat of paint too, so now you can plan your ambushes in levels that offer plenty of potential for planning a tactical attack on the good guys.


Next Milestone
Going off of the last point, our next milestone will focus on the overworld where you choose the place to ambush, along with some other cool things - so watch this space... or Steam news hub, I guess.


Follow Kasper on X
Too excited to wait? Join the Outlaw Kingdom Discord to see progress as it happens, and for potential testing opportunities 👀

notes.title: DevBlog: Base Unit
notes.content:
We have been a little quiet, but that doesn't mean progress has been slow—in fact, quite the opposite! We're excited to share that we just finished our first milestone for the new Outlaw Kingdom demo!
In this news hub update, we will highlight some of the items of this first milestone and tease what may be coming in the next milestone.

Auto Batteling
A huge focus of the new direction we have planned for the Outlaw Kingdom is the Auto Batteling mechanics, allowing you to meticulously set up your ambush and then watch everything play out in real time.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43909477/37ac8488cf1bdd55022b531da4598c427cc8f7b9.gif


Trying out different UI/UX designs
The first version of the new unit selection UI can be seen below. We want to keep it as clean as possible while offering more details when and where you need them, like when hovering over a unit or holding down an action key like Ctrl, Alt, or Space.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43909477/ce2bfc5275a3cb7bbbf7b28ddae95e9246c0a28e.png


Game feel
We have already been implementing the first set of abilities for all the different units and have begun balancing these initial abilities so we can start to get a feel for how this new direction for Outlaw Kindom will feel to play. So far, we are super happy with the game feel and have moved on to our next set of milestones to keep you up to date with our development process so you can see how we are progressing.

New Art
Along with all the changes we are making, it felt weird to have the old Steam page art showcasing the way the game used to look, so we have updated the artwork on the Steam page to match our new style!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43909477/08ffec7154a6847dddedafba10725661d5021806.png


Next Milestone
Our next milestone will focus on the ambush mechanic that some of you who played the demo may already be familiar with. We will also create our own terrain models to help tie the new characters' style to the environment's style. Something we are super hyped for! And we hope you will be too! (This is most likely what the next Steam post will be about 👀)
Haven't seen the new Chracters style yet? See our previous post: https://steamcommunity.com/games/2367460/announcements/detail/4163085355276814465

notes.title: A fresh coat of paint
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43909477/ab30020d2109ab87e5ce76dcb85b89c84cd25dce.png
As they say, out with the old and in with the new...
But why change styles?
With Outlaw Kingdom's new direction, we wanted to add some more species to the game to enhance the fantasy feel. But the character models' old style didn't fit this new direction, so we updated them!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43909477/0e1e4c6024575304c6fdd5a1038126e00c4c375f.png
Our own Style
We set out to create a style that is uniquely ours, and I believe we have done that!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43909477/7379d343a0f622be7592dd88183c2139f58d8b65.gif

In future posts, we will share some more art, concepts, and development of Outlaw Kingdom.
IF you want to follow the development more closely, I invite you to join the Outlaw Kingdom Discord Server.

notes.title: We got a publisher!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43909477/cca5228638b51d6812fefa87aa3c0dbf02f10900.png
I'm happy to announce that Spelkollektivet is now publishing Outlaw Kingdom!
To give you some background information, Spelkollektivet is a game developer hub in Sweden that combines living and working spaces. I have been residing at Spelkollektivet for almost a year now, and I am thrilled to share that my game, Outlaw Kingdom, has recently been signed to be published by Spelkollektivet! This post will detail what that means for the future of Outlaw Kingdom (tl:dr - Only good things!)

What does this mean for Outlaw Kingdom?
Well... More team members!
Because of this publishing deal, I have been able to hire an Artist to work on the game full-time! Together, we have decided on a new art style for the game, which we will share in our next news post! So stay tuned for that 👀

Complete rework of the game.
During the last year, I have received plenty of feedback regarding the game, whether from people who played the demo here on Steam or observations that I made while watching people play at events like Copenhagen Games Week. All of the feedback and observations have led to a complete overhaul of the game, including new mechanics, art styles, and characters, which are currently being worked on as you read this news update.

More fantasy species.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43909477/a25af9f9d9a24fbb46928e68f96074feea42b479.png
Above is a sneak peek of new species being added to the game. We are expanding our world to include Ogres, Elves, and Dwarfs (among other species) to create a more fantasy feel.✨
As mentioned previously in this news update, the next few posts will dive into detail about the new direction of Outlaw Kingdom. 


And finally, thank you...
Thank you for expressing so much interest in the game in its current state, I only hope that we will be able to build upon the feedback you've expressed and make Outlaw Kingdom into a really fun game.

See you in the next post!
